title: Disappointing.
text: This was my first ever Funko subscription and Smuggler’s bounty box. Was very excited based on past boxes and reviews but was super disappointed when I got mine. The “Movie moment” Funko was basically the only good thing, but certainly not worth almost $33. The other item of “mystery Funko” and the keychain were worthless. Such a disappointment. Thankfully my box wasn’t destroyed, but heard a lot of people’s were and missing items. And buyer beware! If shipping gets damaged, they DO NOT replace on this item. Ridiculous. The way it was shipped was flimsy and is easy to see how it could be destroyed. Such a shame the Amazon customer service doesn’t seem to apply to this box.  Giving this subscription one more chance, and if it sucks, def going to cancel.
label: negative
